text:
Sam Patel: FYI — NovaEdge marketplace listing is blocked. Vendor hasn't provided staging credentials, and the PO signer on their side doesn't match the contract. Need help unblocking so we can validate integration.
Jessica Li: we've repeatedly asked, they claim the keys were uploaded to their portal, not shared with us. I requested an S3 path and got back a placeholder.
Sam Patel: @Jessica can you paste the last message?/ link?
Jessica Li: vendor: "uploaded file staging-keys/novaline/staging-key.json to our portal (link)" — they didn't share the file. :face_with_raised_eyebrow: 
Priya Rao: We need the signed PO and the signer authority doc. If their signer is a reseller, we need a reseller agreement or delegation. Can you ask them for an official signer email + phone and gov ID redaction?
Marco Gomez: Also need to confirm PO format: our procurement requires purchaser entity + remit-to account. If reseller signs, finance needs an invoice flow. @Jessica do we have the draft PO?
Jessica Li: attaching copy (sent earlier): PO# NE-9921 (they used vendor legal name NovaLine Solutions, but our contract uses NovaEdge Technologies). They used reseller billing address.
Hana Kim: This will block the staging deploy — QA needs credentials by EOD to run smoke tests for the marketplace listing.
Sam Patel: Action list: 1) Jessica: confirm exact file path & request direct S3 presigned link or send file to vendor-ops@redwood.com; 2) Jessica: request official signer info & reseller delegation or updated PO; 3) Priya: prepare minimal acceptance checklist for signer docs; 4) Marco: advise on interim finance workaround (can we accept reseller invoice with PO mapping?).
Jessica Li: pinged vendor again, asked for presigned S3 link and a signed letter of delegation. They replied: "processing, will escalate to procurement."
vendor-bot: New vendor-submission created VS-3421 for NovaEdge — assigned to Jessica Li.
Priya Rao: If they can't produce delegation by EOD we can accept an Exec Confirmation + legal redline that includes indemnity/representations. Will draft a short template.
Marco Gomez: If we accept Exec Confirmation, finance needs a mapping doc that ties PO# to our billing entity. I'll provision a temp mapping form.
Sam Patel: Thanks. If vendor provides presigned link, QA will run tests within 2 hours. If not by 5pm PT we escalate to Channel Ops and marketplace ops for an emergency review.
Jessica Li: vendor just sent presigned link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/vendor-uploads/novaline/staging-key.json?X — downloading now.
Hana Kim: got it, starting smoke tests.
Hana Kim: smoke tests passed 3/3, but integration fails on callback URL due to mismatch in seller ID.
Priya Rao: that's the signer mismatch we anticipated. Jessica, ask them to reissue PO with exact legal entity name "NovaEdge Technologies, Inc." or provide delegation.
Jessica Li: asked for reissued PO, they said change will take 48h. They offered an interim signed letter. Sending now.
Marco Gomez: provisional acceptance: finance can accept interim letter + map to our billing entity, but need formal PO within 14 days or we must suspend billing.
Sam Patel: Okay, proceeding with interim acceptance. Marking as high priority. I'll create a Deal Desk ticket and loop Channel Ops.
Sam Patel: /dealdesk create NovaEdge staging creds blocker VS-3421 high
deal-desk-bot: Ticket DD-1178 created: NovaEdge staging creds + signer mismatch. Assigned to Channel Ops.
Sam Patel: Thanks everyone — can we reconvene if we don't have final PO by Friday?
Jessica Li: noted, will follow up and post updates here. :thumbsup: 
Priya Rao: I'll post the legal template in the ticket.
Marco Gomez: I'll attach the mapping form.
Hana Kim: QA will queue regression tests once final PO/credentials are confirmed.
Sam Patel: closing for now, tracking in DD-1178. Any urgent updates post 5pm PT ping me directly.
